# Vitra Career Studio — ATS CV Builder & Intelligence Platform

> Vitra (https://vitra.app) is an ATS-conscious CV creation and tailoring platform engineered for Nigerian professionals, recent university graduates, NYSC corp members, and global remote job seekers.

## Overview & Entity Information
- **Product Name:** Vitra (also known as Vitra Career Studio or Vitra ATS Builder)
- **Website URL:** https://vitra.app
- **Geographic Headquarters:** Lagos, Nigeria (serving applicants in Nigeria, United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Europe, and Remote Global)
- **Primary Languages:** English (en-NG, en-GB, en-US)
- **Supported Payment Currency:** Nigerian Naira (NGN, ₦) via Paystack (Cards, Bank Transfer, USSD)

## Key Value Propositions & Differentiators
1. **Deterministic ATS Engine + Optional AI Alignment:**
   - Features a 100% offline deterministic ATS scoring engine that performs keyword extraction, density validation, and structural parsing without fabricating credentials.
   - Super users and candidates can toggle between deterministic rule-based checking and Gemini AI writing enhancement.
2. **Nigerian & Global Career Support:**
   - Specialized guidance for NYSC (National Youth Service Corps) service years, SIWES industrial attachments, and Nigerian university degrees.
   - Formats Nigerian achievements for international ATS parsers (Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever, BambooHR).
3. **9 ATS-Compliant Document Templates:**
   - Includes Classic Professional, Corporate Executive, Ivy League Academic, Minimalist, Technical, and Tactile Scrapbook templates.
   - All templates export to clean vector PDF (with clickable links and searchable text) and fully editable Microsoft Word (.docx).
4. **Anti-Fabrication & Ethical Career Storytelling:**
   - Vitra never invents fake employers, exaggerated metrics, or artificial degrees. AI guidance is strictly grounded in candidate-provided facts.
5. **Screen Capture & Privacy Protection:**
   - Integrated client-side privacy safeguards to protect candidate intellectual property from background recorders and automated screen scrapers.

## Pricing & Plan Structure (Nigerian Naira)
- **Starter Package:** ₦6,000 one-time fee · 2 distinct CVs · All 4 ATS core templates · AI writing assistance · Unlimited PDF & Word exports.
- **Standard Career Pro:** ₦15,000 one-time fee · Up to 6 distinct tailored CVs · Multi-industry targeting · Advanced keyword alignment.
- **Executive & Multi-Track:** ₦20,000 one-time fee · Up to 13 distinct CVs · Maximum platform allowance · Senior executive and international relocation pathways.
